chapter_focus: Mindful Eating — food groups, balanced diet, deficiency diseases, healthy habits.
intro: Resources for chapter 3 on nutrition and healthy eating. Admin should validate that links are live and culturally appropriate before publishing to the catalog.

items.title: DIKSHA — Class 6 Science Chapter 3
items.summary: Government of India's official online learning portal. Search for 'Class 6 Mindful Eating' for textbook-aligned video and worksheet content.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: confirm chapter 3 specific content is available; the portal updates with each NCERT revision.

items.title: Eat Right India — FSSAI Resources
items.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India's portal with kid-friendly nutrition guides, posters, and 'Eat Right School' resources.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: download the 'Eat Right School' poster pack — useful for classroom display.

items.title: WHO — Healthy Diet for Children
items.summary: World Health Organization article on dietary needs for school-age children, including balanced-plate guidance and red-flag deficiency symptoms.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: pick the latest fact sheet and link directly.

items.title: ICMR-NIN — Dietary Guidelines for Indians
items.summary: Indian Council of Medical Research's National Institute of Nutrition publishes the official 'Dietary Guidelines for Indians' — a great teacher reference.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: download the PDF; use the children's section for class material.

items.title: BBC Bitesize — Healthy Eating
items.summary: Short BBC Bitesize lessons on healthy eating, food groups, and balanced meals. Designed for primary school but engaging for Class 6.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: confirm the page renders well in your school network.
